sections.heading: Keep Salesloft on the shortlist only if…
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Shortlist when Choose Salesloft when enterprise sales engagement and bi-directional CRM sync are the job — not when you need a contact database. beat the migration cost. Counter-signal: Drop when Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core outweighs Salesloft Platform value.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Salesloft Platform.

sections.heading: Who Salesloft is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Salesloft when enterprise sales engagement and bi-directional CRM sync are the job — not when you need a contact database..

Avoid if: Compare Outreach as the primary SEP peer; Apollo/Reply for SMB data+engage; Instantly for cold-email infra; ZoomInfo/Apollo when contact data is primary..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Outreach on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Salesloft price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
